semantic_anchor: A wrong ending sends training back through the saved cards
prompt: Premium cinematic educational illustration, landscape 16:9, titled 'One card. Two useful paths.' A midnight music studio with deep navy atmosphere, dimensional spotlights, luminous cyan memory ribbons, violet prediction beams, gold note glyphs, ivory piano keys, tactile folded score cards and circular synthesizer dials. Beautiful crafted musical objects, NOT a wall of rectangles. THREE left-to-right workstations reuse the SAME RNN weights and SAME note-head weights. Station 1: the explicit input pair 'D3 + h0' enters a circular RNN dial and produces folded card 'h1'. Station 2: 'A3 + h1' produces 'h2'. Station 3: 'D4 + h2' produces 'h3'. From EACH h card, visibly FORK into two paths: CYAN carries the card to the next station's incoming h port; VIOLET exposes the SAME h to a circular 'shared note head', then a GOLD note token labelled respectively 'guess n2', 'guess n3', 'guess n4'. The final h3 also carries to a 'next read' cue. All THREE prediction branches must be present. The exposed and carried h are the same values, not separate vectors. Important labels must be large and legible. Footer: 'Carry h. Expose the SAME h to predict.' and 'Every step predicts; the replay below traces note 4 error.' Small note: 'h0 starts blank'. This is a FORWARD-PATH concept illustration only: do not draw any backward feedback ribbons, targets, error boxes or training arrows. Do not invent predicted pitches, probabilities, numerical results or musical understanding. Avoid tiny text, clutter, logos and copyrighted characters.
acceptance_criteria: Rich cinematic musical illustration rather than plain blocks. Correct explicit input pairs D3/h0, A3/h1, D4/h2. Each produced h visibly forks to carry forward AND expose to a shared note head. Three next-note output labels guess n2, guess n3, guess n4. Exposed h and carried h are the same state. This poster shows forward paths; the measured replay handles backpropagation. Large readable text.
prohibited_content: Missing per-step outputs, unrelated output-state vectors, hidden incoming inputs, wrong h indices, backward training arrows in this forward poster, attention heads, LSTM gates, invented scores or pitches, autonomous musical understanding, tiny labels, walls of boxes, logos, copyrighted characters.
postprocessing: The first cinematic generation included incorrect feedback arrows. The final PNG was locally relabelled with incoming h0/h1/h2 badges, and the unreliable lower diagram was replaced with a forward-path legend and a piano-key foreground. The prompt above is the reviewed forward-only regeneration prompt. One MAI call was used; measured values belong to the separate local replay.
alt_text: Three musical RNN stations combine each note with its incoming hidden state. Every produced h forks into a cyan carry path and a violet shared prediction head producing the next-note guess. Only the note-four error is traced backward.
